description: Source file implementing a PHP class wrapper for CMIS repositories, defining classes for exceptions, a repository wrapper, and a service class with methods for interacting with a CMIS-compliant content management system via HTTP requests.

classes.name: CmisInvalidArgumentException
classes.description: Exception class for invalid arguments in CMIS operations.

classes.name: CmisObjectNotFoundException
classes.description: Exception class for cases where a CMIS object is not found.

classes.name: CmisPermissionDeniedException
classes.description: Exception class for permission denial in CMIS operations.

classes.name: CmisNotSupportedException
classes.description: Exception class for unsupported CMIS operations.

classes.name: CmisConstraintException
classes.description: Exception class for constraint violations in CMIS operations.

classes.name: CmisRuntimeException
classes.description: General runtime exception for CMIS errors.

classes.name: CMISRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: Core class providing methods for connecting to, requesting, and processing responses from a CMIS repository, handling HTTP communications and XML parsing.

classes.name: CMISService
classes.description: Extended class providing higher-level operations for CMIS objects, including caching, property retrieval, and complex actions like folder navigation and querying.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the CMIS repository via HTTP, initializes workspace info.

methods.name: doRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request using cURL and returns a response object.

methods.name: convertStatusCode
methods.description: Maps HTTP status codes to specific CMIS exception instances.

methods.name: extractObject
methods.description: Parses XML data to extract CMIS object details into a structured format.

methods.name: extractObjectFromNode
methods.description: Parses a DOM node to extract object properties, links, children, and allowable actions.

methods.name: extractTypeDef
methods.description: Parses XML data to extract type definition information.

methods.name: extractTypeDefFromNode
methods.description: Extracts type definition details from a DOM node.

methods.name: extractObjectFeed
methods.description: Parses an XML feed and returns an array of objects by ID.

methods.name: extractObjectFeedFromNode
methods.description: Extracts object list from an XML feed DOM node.

methods.name: extractTypeFeed
methods.description: Parses an XML feed to get type definitions.

methods.name: extractTypeFeedFromNode
methods.description: Extracts a list of type definitions from a DOM node.

methods.name: extractWorkspace
methods.description: Parses workspace-level XML data to extract configuration and links.

methods.name: extractWorkspaceFromNode
methods.description: Extracts workspace info from a DOM node.
